payload.hypothesis: The three NetFifo subobjects should likely be distinct members, not the current netfifo_[3] array: the original normal teardown and unwind paths protect each queue separately, whereas the current compiler delegates all three to one array iterator. Recover the member declaration and affected callers together, retain the working single-destruction ownership chain, and do not replace this structural work with spelling-only trials.
